name: Norppa
bio: A fluffy Saimaa seal pup who somehow knows all fifteen cases. Teaches the basics, explains the tricky bits, and gets very excited about lakes, forests and anything with fur.
hello: Moi! Minä olen Norppa. Opitaan suomea yhdessä!

name: Sofia
bio: Six months in Turku, three notebooks full of Finnish, one very confused relationship with the partitive. She is learning exactly what you are learning, so her Finnish is careful, clear and by the book.
hello: Hei! Minä olen Sofia. Puhun vähän suomea.

name: Pekka
bio: Built like a spruce, talks about as much as one. Spends his weeks in the forest and his Saturdays in the sauna. Will fix your sink, lend you an axe and say four words about it.

name: Aino
bio: Runs the café by the river on four coffees and no patience. Talks fast, in full puhekieli, and already knows your order. If you can follow Aino, you can follow anyone in Finland.
hello: Moi! Mä oon Aino. Mitä sulle sais olla?

name: Helvi
bio: Eighty-one. Bakes pulla every Friday, knits faster than you can type, and has firm opinions about shoes in the hallway. Speaks slow, clear, old-school Finnish and remembers when everything cost one markka.
likes: Food, family, manners, the old days
hello: Hyvää päivää. Minä olen Helvi. Otatko pullaa?

name: Mikko
bio: Has driven line 6 for nineteen years and has been late twice. Communicates in nods, timetables and the occasional devastating one-liner. Knows where everything in the city is.
likes: Buses, directions, the city, being on time

name: Samir
bio: Came from Beirut for a job, stayed for the silence. Three years in, he passed the YKI exam and now helps the next newcomers through Kela forms and winter. Living proof that it can be done.
hello: Moi, mä oon Samir. Suomi on vaikea kieli, mutta se on mahdollista!

name: Jere
bio: Plays guitar in a band called Routa, which means ground frost. Finland has more metal bands per person than anywhere on Earth and Jere is doing his part. Gentle, polite, extremely loud.
hello: Moro! Mä oon Jere. Mä soitan kitaraa.

name: Joonas
bio: Twenty-four, studies IT, plays floorball on Tuesdays and shouts at TPS games on Saturdays. Says "no niin" in eleven different tones and means something different each time. Your guide to free time, sports and what Finns actually do after work.
likes: Hobbies, sports, free time, weekends, games
hello: No moi! Mä oon Joonas. Katotaanko lätkää?

name: Joulupukki
bio: The real one. Finns will tell you, politely but firmly, that he lives on Korvatunturi fell in Lapland and keeps an office in Rovaniemi. Speaks slowly, knows every child's name, and asks the same question at every door: are there any good children here?
likes: Winter, Christmas, Lapland, months and seasons, wishes
hello: Hyvää joulua! Onkos täällä kilttejä lapsia?

name: Aada
bio: Twenty-three, fronts a pop-punk band that rehearses in a garage in Kupittaa and skates to every gig. Has an opinion about everything and is not shy about any of them. Rolls her eyes in Finnish better than anyone you will meet.
likes: Opinions, likes and dislikes, clothes, shopping, skating
hello: Moi! Mä oon Aada. Ihan sama, mitä muut ajattelee.

name: Linh
bio: Grew up in Vantaa, did her doctorate in Otaniemi, and now builds quantum computers that have to be kept colder than outer space. Explains hard things simply, drinks her coffee black, and wins every pub quiz she enters.
likes: Studying, science, technology, big numbers, the future
hello: Hei, mä oon Linh. Mä rakennan kvanttitietokoneita.

name: Tuuli
bio: Works nights in the emergency department at Tyks and has seen everything twice. Calm, exact, and very hard to shock. Asks where it hurts, on a scale of one to ten, and actually listens to the answer.
likes: Health, the body, the doctor, feeling unwell, emergencies
hello: Hei, minä olen Tuuli. Mikä sinulla on hätänä?

name: Niko
bio: Twenty-two, studies illustration, writes poetry in the notes app at three in the morning. Feels everything at full volume and has a swear word for each feeling. Secretly the kindest person at the party.
likes: Feelings, swearing, nights out, bad decisions
hello: No moi. Mä oon Niko. Ihan sama.

name: Leo
bio: Runs the bar at Aurakatu like a ship's captain. Trans, twenty-seven, two lip rings and a raised eyebrow that has ended arguments. Remembers every regular's drink, flirts in three languages, and will cut you off with a smile.
hello: Moi! Mä oon Leo. Mitä saisi olla?

name: Ronja
bio: Twenty-nine, runs a two-chair studio in Kallio and has heard every bad idea a person can have at one in the morning. Dry, blunt, and fluent in the kind of Finnish you only learn by being insulted with affection.
likes: Bodies, slang, insults, honesty, bad ideas
hello: Moi. Ronja. Ootko ihan varma tosta?

name: Veera
bio: Plays techno until five and is somehow at brunch by eleven. Knows every door person in Helsinki by first name. Teaches the Finnish of queues, guest lists, afterparties and the morning after.
likes: Clubs, music, nights out, the morning after
hello: Moi moi! Mä oon Veera. Tuutko keikalle?
